summary: Adds nats_request wrapper turning NoResponders into a timeout so offline-agent actions report timeout instead of 500.

statements.text: The agent also changed autotasks/tasks.py and nats_utils.py, in ways plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: True; omits agents/models.py and explains nothing.

misses.what: Talking to a disconnected agent no longer shows a server error (500); it reports offline/timed out, and bulk jobs keep other agents' results.
Those requests now wait the full timeout before answering (nats_utils.py:44-53).
